title.narrative: Caritas Norway Humanitarian Emergency Repsonse Project in South Sudan

description.narrative: This is Caritas Norway 4 years project which started in 2020. The project was extended by 1 more year and this approval is raised for the implementation of the 5th and final year of thie project. Programme components remain largely the same as in the previous years (1-4). However, in this Y5 although the project will continue to work with the 1600 households, the nature of support will slightly change. For example, inputs such as seeds and tools, ox-plough, life-saving food assistance, WASH NFIs will be targeted to returnees from Sudan. Working along the humanitarian, development and peace nexus the project will continue to strengthen community resilience to shocks through support for durable solutions in food security, through farmer trainings on climate change adapted farming practices, hygiene promotion, strengthen Psychosocial Support Services (PSS) groups and continued support of case management and referral networks. The project will continue to meet protection needs through Gender Based Violence (GBV) case management, strengthening referral pathways and psychosocial support groups. In year 5, advocacy work on Community Based Natural Resources Management will be strengthened through Community Natural Resources Management Committees, and engaging key stakeholders at county and state levels. Groups will be encouraged to develop their proposals and grants provided to suppot those community projects.
